run_a_node.title: 运行 Morphit 节点
run_a_node.subtitle: 运营你自己的实例。赚取挂单费用分成。帮助让 Morphit 不可审查。
run_a_node.why_uncensor_title: 在重要的地方运行 Morphit
run_a_node.why_uncensor_body: 每增加一个节点都会让网络更难被审查。如果你的国家屏蔽 morphit.io,你的实例仍可达。你在服务那些否则无法交易的用户。
run_a_node.why_community_body: 为你的地区、你的语言、你的本地支付方式定制界面。用户信任说他们语言、让他们觉得熟悉的前端 —— 你的前端将是这样。
run_a_node.why_privacy_body: 通过你的实例交易的用户只与你分享元数据。没有其他运营者,甚至 Agorise 也看不到他们的活动模式。
run_a_node.why_earn_body:
你实例吸引的每一笔以 BLURT 支付的发布费向你支付 90% — 仅 10% 进入 Morphit 财库,用于资助欢迎奖励、忠诚度委托和账户创建成本。以 BTC 和 XMR 支付的费用 100% 流向财库,用于同样的项目义务(链上分配机制仅适用于 BLURT,但我们使 BLURT 分配积极慷慨以弥补 — 90/10 对你有利,而不是我们最初考虑的 50/50)。

运行在 Blurt 链上的 Smart Contract 强制执行分配 — 不是某个人、某个公司、某个可以改变主意的人。100% 自动化。无发票、无手动支付、无信任假设。你可证明地帮助,你可证明地获得报酬。在代码中保证。

支付以 BLURT 计价,所以如果 BLURT 升值,你的收入也升值 — 无需额外工作。在 AGPL-3.0 下完全开源;如果你能阅读索引器源代码,你就能审计支付逻辑。
run_a_node.step1_body: Linux(Debian 12、Ubuntu 22.04+、Arch、NixOS — 我们在 Debian 上测试)。2 核 CPU @ 1 GHz+,最低 2 GB RAM(4 GB 舒适),20 GB SSD。Raspberry Pi 4、旧笔记本电脑或 5 美元/月的 VPS 都可以。不需要静态 IP — DDNS 工作得很好。请参阅 FAQ 中关于最低硬件要求的条目以获取爱好者、认真和旧笔记本电脑层级的完整细分。
run_a_node.step2_body: 派生或克隆 git.agorise.net/agorise/morphit。从 ops/env/ 复制 env 示例,设置你的域名,设置 indexer 的 RPC 端点（公共 Blurt 节点开箱即用）。
run_a_node.step3_body: indexer 和 relay 的 systemd 单元在 ops/systemd/。带 TLS 的 nginx 配置在 ops/nginx/。运行迁移工具一次来初始化数据库架构。
run_a_node.step4_body: 使用你选择的标签(1-64 个字符,字母数字 + 破折号/下划线/点)运行 register-operator CLI 工具。标签是先到先得 — 一旦你广播一次性 `morphit_register_operator` 操作,该标签就是你的。你的实例出现在 /operators 中,立即开始归属订单(并赚取你以 BLURT 支付的发布费的 90% 份额)。请参阅运营商收入 FAQ 了解完整经济学。
run_a_node.asset_policy_heading: 你的实例,你的资产政策
run_a_node.asset_policy_body: Morphit 的联邦让每个运营方选择其实例为哪些可交易资产接受新订单。新资产默认在实例范围内开启交付——运营方通过 `MORPHIT_INDEXER_DISABLED_ASSETS` 环境变量按资产逐个禁用。这样一个实例联邦可以服务不同的用户偏好,而无需任何人 fork 代码。
run_a_node.asset_policy_default_body: 当项目添加新的可交易资产时(USDT 是最近的一个),每个实例在升级时即开始接受相关订单。无需代码更改,无需按资产逐个启用步骤。
run_a_node.asset_policy_opt_out_label: 一个环境变量即可拒绝。
run_a_node.asset_policy_opt_out_body: 希望其实例专注于隐私优先或去中心化优先资产的运营方,可通过 `MORPHIT_INDEXER_DISABLED_ASSETS="USDT"`(或逗号分隔的列表表示多个)禁用任何仅交易资产。通过此运营方前端发布的用户无法选择已禁用的资产。
run_a_node.asset_policy_federation_body: 在你的实例上禁用某资产不会向你的用户隐藏对等实例的订单——链历史是共享的,所以 orderbook 仍以只读方式显示它们。禁用仅适用于从你的实例发布的新订单。

run_a_node.req_network_value: 家庭互联网就可以 — DDNS 处理动态 IP,不需要静态 IP
run_a_node.cta_body: 克隆仓库,设置硬件(Pi 4 或任何旧笔记本电脑都可以),按照 runbook 操作。一旦你广播 register-operator 操作,你的实例就上线并赚钱。

verify_peer.tamper_body: 索引器为此联系人提供的聊天密钥与链上记录不一致。这是中间人或被入侵的强烈信号。在搞清楚原因之前，请勿信任此对话。

verify_peer.compare_body: 通过语音通话、当面或其他可信渠道把这 8 个词读给联系人。不要在本聊天里比对。哪怕只有一个词不同，也应将对话视为已被破坏。
verify_peer.why_body: 默认情况下，Morphit 聊天信任索引器递送的对方聊天密钥。恶意索引器可能换上攻击者控制的密钥并读取你的消息。8 个词的指纹是基于双方真实聊天密钥在本地计算的——如果双方看到相同的词，则不存在中间人攻击。这只防御中间人攻击；它不能证明电话另一端的人就是其声称的身份。

download.title: 获取 Morphit Android 版
download.subtitle: Morphit 通过多个应用商店提供 — 不只是 Google Play。一个渠道是单一审查点;八个渠道不是。
download.verify_body: 每个构建的 SHA-256 哈希都发布在 Blurt 链上。无论你从哪个商店下载,都可以验证 APK 未被篡改。
download.graphene_heading: 最佳路径:Pixel 上的 GrapheneOS
download.graphene_body: GrapheneOS 是我们实际推荐给 Morphit 用户的以隐私为重心的 Android。没有 Google sideload 限制,不需要 Google 账户,与所有 Android 应用完全兼容。在 Google Pixel 手机上运行。
download.sideload_faq_cta: 为什么在原生 Android 上 sideload 困难
download.web_body: Morphit 在任何移动浏览器中完整运行。Firefox、Brave、Android 版 Tor Browser — 选一个就走。无需安装、无需权限、与应用商店没有任何关系。
download.iphone_body: 是的,iPhone 用户可以完全使用 Morphit — 无需越狱。苹果应用商店不列出非 KYC 的 P2P 加密应用,所以没有原生 iOS 应用。相反,你通过 Safari 将 Morphit 作为渐进式 Web 应用(PWA)安装。结果表现得像普通应用:主屏幕图标、全屏启动、离线浏览能力。
download.iphone_step_1: 在 Safari 中打开此站点(不是 Chrome 或 Firefox — 只有 Safari 可以在 iOS 上安装 PWA)。
download.iphone_step_2: 点击共享图标(屏幕底部带向上箭头的方块)。
download.iphone_step_3: 向下滚动并点击「添加到主屏幕」。
download.iphone_step_4: 点击右上角的「添加」。Morphit 图标现在在你的主屏幕上,并以全屏模式启动。
download.iphone_jailbreak_note: 建议 iOS 16.4 或更新版本以获得完整的 PWA 支持(service workers、推送通知)。较旧的 iOS 版本仍可工作 — 图标安装并加载站点 — 但离线能力降低。
download.iphone_faq_cta: 在 FAQ 中阅读更多
download.operator_section_title: 运行您自己的 Morphit 实例
download.operator_section_subtitle: 任何人都可以运行 Morphit 节点 — 您自己的品牌、您自己的用户、您自己的费用收入。联邦自动找到您。下面是您需要的一切。
download.operator_source_body: Morphit 采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证。克隆仓库、运行冒烟测试套件、部署。每个发布版本都经过签名，其 SHA-256 清单发布在 Blurt 链上，以便您验证克隆的内容与项目发布的内容一致。
download.operator_verify_note: 每个发布工件（APK、源代码 tarball、容器镜像）的 SHA-256 哈希通过 `morphit_release_v1` 操作记录在 Blurt 链上。本地重新哈希并与链上清单对比即可验证任何下载。
download.operator_setup_body: 我们不发布预构建的 `.deb` 或 `.rpm` 包 — Morphit 是多组件服务器（Postgres + Node.js 索引器 + 中继 + 反向代理），单包安装会向您隐藏架构。运营手册将带您逐步完成。
download.operator_setup_doc_run: RUN-A-MORPHIT-NODE.md — 完整的首次部署指南
download.operator_setup_doc_ops: OPERATIONS.md — 持续运营手册（备份、充值、RPC 管理）
download.operator_setup_doc_switching: SWITCHING-NETWORKS.md — 暂存程序 + 上线检查清单
download.operator_setup_doc_security: SECURITY.md — 披露渠道 + 威胁模型
download.operator_distros_body: 已在 Debian 12 和 Ubuntu 22.04+ 上测试，但应能在任何带 Node.js 22+ 和 Postgres 15+ 的现代 Linux（Arch、Alpine、NixOS）上运行。FreeBSD 经少量调整可工作。硬件：任何带 4 GB RAM 和 20 GB SSD 的双核 ARM64 或 x86-64 机器 — 大多数运营者使用 Raspberry Pi 4、Intel 迷你 PC 或备用笔记本。
download.operator_distros_faq_cta: 查看完整硬件/操作系统要求
download.operator_join_body: 一旦您的实例上线并广播 `morphit_operator_register_v1`，它就会自动出现在每个其他 Morphit 实例的目录中。无需申请、无需许可、无需中心化列表。

sign_out_modal.body:
你需要 12 词助记词或 keyfile 才能重新登录。你的 posting 和 memo 密钥将立即从此会话的内存中擦除。

backup_keys.title: 备份你的密钥
backup_keys.subtitle: 这是 Morphit 上最重要的页面。在你需要它之前就读一读。
backup_keys.reality_lead: Morphit 是非托管的。没有任何人 — 不是我们,不是你的操作员,不是任何地方的任何支持代理 — 能在你丢失密钥后帮你恢复账户。
backup_keys.reality_body:
没有'忘记密码'链接。没有'用身份证验证'流程。没有服务器上的备用账户。你的密钥存在于两个地方:这台设备(现在)和你复制它们的任何地方。就这些。

丢失密钥,丢失账户。丢失资金。丢失你从每笔交易中建立的信誉。没有例外、没有申诉、地球上没有任何人能够干预。

这是一个无法也不能扣押你的钱或冻结你账户的服务的权衡。同样的东西让你免受我们伤害,也让你暴露于自己的错误中。
backup_keys.reality_slogan: 在加密世界里,你就是银行。
backup_keys.seed_heading: 1. 你的 12 词助记词(最重要)
backup_keys.seed_body:
你的助记词是标准的 BIP-39 助记词 — 12 个词,在 onboarding 时生成。世界上任何兼容 BIP-39 的钱包都可以从它重新生成你的密钥。这是你的终极恢复手段。

如果你在 onboarding 时没有记下它,它就消失了。我们无法重新生成它。在它从内存中擦除之前,你的密钥已经从它派生出来了。
backup_keys.seed_tip_paper: 写在纸上。两份副本,存放在两个不同的物理位置。
backup_keys.seed_tip_steel: 对于你在意的金额,把它刻在钢板上。纸会烧、会被水泡。
backup_keys.seed_tip_split: 对于更大的余额,把它分开:前 6 个词放一个地方,后 6 个放另一个地方。两半在一起 = 完全访问。任一半单独 = 什么都没有。
backup_keys.seed_tip_digital_warning: 绝不要将种子存在电子邮件、云笔记、截图、同步到云的密码管理器或任何可远程访问的应用中。
backup_keys.keyfile_body: 你的会话使用密码加密的 keyfile 启动。现在重新下载,并将它存放在与你正在使用的设备分开的地方。如果你忘记密码,keyfile 就没用了 — 所以要把密码当作同等关键的东西对待。
backup_keys.keyfile_locked_hint: 先登录才能下载你的加密 keyfile。本页在不登录的情况下也可用 — 供教育部分使用。
backup_keys.keyfile_download_err_locked: 你的会话似乎已锁定。登录以下载你的 keyfile。
backup_keys.redundancy_body:
加密幸存者是那些为火灾、洪水、死亡和自己健忘做好计划的人。

你的助记词两份物理副本放在不同位置。至少一份在保险箱或银行保险柜中。考虑遗产计划:如果你出事,可信赖的继承人如何找到你的密钥?把说明与密钥本身分开写。

冗余花你 10 分钟工夫。它的缺失可以让你失去一切。
backup_keys.antipatterns_heading: 让人失去一切的常见错误
backup_keys.anti_email: 把助记词发邮件给自己。你邮件提供商的任何泄露都会暴露它。
backup_keys.anti_cloud: 把种子存在 Google Drive、iCloud、Dropbox、OneDrive。它们被自动化恶意软件扫描,被政府传唤,被攻击者入侵。
backup_keys.anti_photo: 给种子拍照。你的照片同步到云端。你的手机被偷。照片泄露。
backup_keys.anti_share: 把种子分享给「支持」— 我们的或任何人的。真正的支持绝对、绝对不会要你的种子。要的人就是骗子。
backup_keys.anti_support: 以为有人能帮你恢复。他们不能。我们不能。没人能。这就是非托管的全部意义。

pay_zec.description: Zcash: launched 2016, zk-SNARK shielded transactions (Sapling + Orchard pools) plus transparent addresses (t1/t3, like Bitcoin). Fair-launched with a founders-reward halving schedule. Per-trade, recipients pick the address type that matches their posture. Trade-only on Morphit — cannot pay listing fees.

pay_arrr.description: Pay in Pirate Chain (ARRR).  Pirate Chain is a proof-of-work cryptocurrency that ships chain-level shielded transactions via the Sapling zk-SNARK pool — sender, recipient, and amount are hidden on-chain by construction.  Single address format (zs1 Sapling shielded).  Use a Pirate Chain wallet like Treasure Chest, Pirate.Black, or the Verus-integrated Pirate wallet.

pay_dcr.description: Pay in Decred (DCR).  Decred is a hybrid Proof-of-Work + Proof-of-Stake cryptocurrency with on-chain governance via Politeia.  Two receive-address formats: Ds (P2PKH) and Dc (P2SH).  Use a Decred wallet like dcrwallet, Decrediton, or Cake Wallet.

welcome_first_buy.heading: 你的第一笔交易由我们承担。🌱
welcome_first_buy.lead: 欢迎来到 Morphit！你的第一个订单是免费的 BLURT 购买——我们承担上架费，你带着真正的起始余额进入你的钱包。这是 P2P 加密货币中最好的入门优惠之一，原因如下：
welcome_first_buy.bullet_free: 上架费免费。Morphit 为这笔交易支付网络费——你唯一的成本是你同意支付给对方的金额。
welcome_first_buy.bullet_starter: 你带着 BLURT 离开。足以以 BLURT 折扣价（每笔约 60 BLURT）资助未来在 Morphit 上的订单，并从第一天起参与 Blurt 社交网络。
welcome_first_buy.bullet_runway: BLURT 在整个 Blurt 社交网络中通用。用它在 blurt.blog、blurt.media 和其他 Blurt 前端为帖子投票——只要为好内容投票就能获得策展奖励。
welcome_first_buy.bullet_bp_stake: 你立即解锁 1 BP 欢迎权益，就在你第一笔以 BLURT 支付的上架费触发的那一刻。第一笔完成的交易后，这会变成 10 BLURT liquid + 10 BLURT Power——Blurt 社交网络中永久的投票权重权益。
welcome_first_buy.why_blurt_minimum: 为什么免费交易要用 BLURT 而不是 BTC 或 XMR？因为你钱包里的 BLURT 是你之后在 Morphit 上做所有其他事情的关键——为未来的交易支付上架费（半价！）、参与 Blurt 社交层、赚取忠诚度奖励。我们希望你能积极参与，而不是带着空 BLURT 余额被困住。

security.heading: 安全姿态
security.subtitle: 我们承诺什么,这对你意味着什么。
security.keys_title: 你的密钥永远不会离开你的设备。
security.keys_body: 密钥使用 libsodium 在你的浏览器中生成。在存储前用你选择的密码加密(Argon2id + XSalsa20-Poly1305)。没有 Morphit 服务器看到它们。
security.tracking_body: 没有 cookie。没有分析。没有第三方脚本。没有 IP 日志。没有遥测。如果你查看浏览器中的网络标签页,每个请求都发往 Morphit,不发往任何其他地方。
security.chat_body: 每条消息使用 X25519 密钥协商加 ChaCha20-Poly1305 认证加密(libsodium 原语),每条消息都有新的临时密钥。明文只存在于你的浏览器和交易伙伴的浏览器中。Morphit 的服务器、Blurt 区块链和中间任何人都只看到密文。完整协议 — 包括我们接受的有意权衡(无逐消息前向保密)— 在 {chat_crypto_doc} 中。
security.reproducible_body: 每个发布都打标签;每个资源都有指纹;SRI 保护每个脚本。你可以从源码重新构建并比较 — 我们在每个发布旁边发布哈希。
security.open_source_body: 完整威胁模型在仓库的 {security_doc} 中。我们明确说明保护什么和不保护什么 — 假装否则比诚实更糟。
security.footer_body: 发现问题?请通过公共 Forgejo 仓库报告,或(在第 5 阶段)通过加密消息发给 Blurt 上的 {morphit_account} 账户。
security.bounty_body: 我们运行一个酌情决定的安全识别计划。每一个可操作的发现都由真实的工程师审查,获得答复,并且 — 如果它实质上改善了 Morphit 的安全态势 — 将在 BLURT(从 @morphit-fees 支付)或 BTC 中获得奖励,根据严重程度和报告质量进行调整。没有固定的等级表;按个案裁定。即使没有付款,名人堂荣誉也可用。完整范围、严重程度指导、付款流程以及我们不会做的事情(没有保密协议,没有独家披露)记录在 SECURITY.md 中。
security.canary_body: 我们发布每周一次的金丝雀,使用运营者的 PGP 密钥签名。金丝雀明确声明没有收到任何 NSL / FISA / 禁言令 / 后门要求。新鲜度证明包括当前的 Blurt 链头、当前的比特币链头和当前的新闻标题(证明金丝雀不能预先生成)。如果金丝雀超过 14 天未更新,请视为静默:运营者可能受到强制压力,你应该切换到另一个联邦运营者。

active_key.title: 活动密钥
active_key.body: 您的 Morphit 账户的三把私钥之一。活动密钥用于转移 BLURT — 支付挂单费、发送打赏、转账余额。Morphit 仅在您即将花费时才会询问(更准确地说,询问可以在您的设备上解锁它的密码)。它从不离开您的浏览器。

blurt.title: BLURT
blurt.body: BLURT 是两个东西:一个区块链(Morphit 的订单操作、费用和加密聊天就在上面),以及您支付挂单费时使用的资产。资产和链共用同一个名字。没有 Morphit 代币 — Morphit 直接使用 BLURT。

blurt_power.title: BLURT Power
blurt_power.body: 您已「升级」(power up)的 BLURT — 质押在账户中,无法立即花费。BLURT Power 在您对 Blurt 内容投票时给您权重(这与 Morphit 是分开的),也是委托的基础。使用 Morphit 不需要任何 BLURT Power;它主要在您将交易公告发布到更广泛的 Blurt 社区时才重要。

broadcast.title: 广播
broadcast.body: 将签名后的操作发送到 Blurt 区块链。发布订单、取消订单、留下反馈、发送加密聊天消息 — 这些都是广播。一旦广播被包含进区块,就无法撤销(该操作永远在链上);只能被后续的操作替代。

counterparty.title: 交易对手
counterparty.body: 交易中的另一方。如果您发布了卖单,有人发消息给您要买,那个人就是您的交易对手。这个词是中性的 — 它不意味着「敌手」。Morphit 上每笔交易的双方都有一个交易对手:每一方都是另一方的交易对手。

custom_json.title: custom_json
custom_json.body: Blurt 区块链上的一种操作类型,用于携带任意结构化数据。Morphit 的订单操作、反馈操作、聊天信封和运营者注册全都是 custom_json 操作 — 它们搭乘现有区块链基础设施,而不需要新建一条链。您不需要直接与 custom_json 打交道;Morphit 会替您构建它们。

delegation.title: 委托
delegation.body: 暂时将您部分 BLURT Power 借给另一个账户,而不交出对底层 BLURT 的控制权。使用 Morphit 不需要委托,但运营者有时会委托给新账户以给予它们初始权重。委托可以撤销(在 BLURT Power 重新变为流动之前有冷却期)。

federation.title: 联邦
federation.body: 多个独立的 Morphit 实例共享同一订单簿和聊天生态系统,因为它们都读取同一条 Blurt 区块链。如果一个运营者下线(或变得敌对),用户可以转到另一个实例,在那里找到相同的订单、相同的交易、相同的信誉。联邦就是让 Morphit 抵御审查的东西。

feedback.title: 反馈
feedback.body: 您在交易结束后留给交易对手的、签名后的链上评价。反馈是永久的 — 不能删除,只能回应。您在 Morphit 的声誉就是其他人随时间为您留下的反馈的总和。每笔已完成交易的双方都有权留下一条反馈。

fiat.title: 法币
fiat.body: 政府发行的货币:美元、欧元、日元、比索、卢布。与加密货币相对。在 Morphit 上,法币是在平台外易手的部分 — 您和交易对手就法币价格(如 USD)达成一致,私下结算法币部分(现金、银行转账,任您选择),Morphit 只处理加密货币部分。

indexer.title: 索引器
indexer.body: Morphit 实例的组件,它监听 Blurt 区块链、解码与 Morphit 相关的操作(订单、反馈、聊天信封),并以可用的形式提供给网页前端。区块链是真实之源;索引器只是一个快速缓存。由运营者运行,不是您。

listing_fee.title: 挂单费
listing_fee.body: 您发布新订单时 Morphit 收取的少量 BLURT 费用。该费用用于支付运营者成本,并打消刷单激励。新账户的第一笔订单免费。挂单费会随您发布频率温和增长。取消订单不会退还挂单费 — 这是挂单的费用,不是交易的费用。

network_fee.title: 网络费
network_fee.body: 口语中有两个不同的东西共用这个名字:(1) Morphit 的挂单费 — 发布订单的 BLURT 成本;以及 (2) 您结算交易加密货币部分时矿工收取的 Bitcoin 或 Monero 链上费用。Morphit 只收取前者;后者是您与底层网络之间的事情,在您进行实际转账时发生。

operator.title: 运营者
operator.body: 运行特定 Morphit 实例的个人或团队 — 您此刻正在浏览的网站由某人运营。运营者运行索引器和中继服务器、为其实例设置策略(速率限制、费率档、紧急停机开关),并赚取通过其实例的挂单费分成。如果运营者变得敌对,您可以切换到另一个实例,在那里找到您相同的订单、相同的交易、相同的信誉。

password.title: 密码
password.body: 用来在您的设备上解锁私钥的东西。Morphit 从不看到、发送、存储或知晓您的密码 — 它在您的浏览器本地用来解密浏览器存储中的加密密钥包。如果您忘了密码,密钥就没了;这就是为什么 Morphit 在入门流程中要求您记下助记词。

permlink.title: permlink (永久链接)
permlink.body: Blurt 区块链上某笔订单的唯一短标识符 — 类似 `morphit-o-2k4f9`。permlink 让您(以及区块链和其他 Morphit 实例)能够无歧义地引用某笔具体订单。任何 Morphit 实例上的订单 URL 都以其 permlink 结尾,因此订单链接在实例之间可以通用。

posting_key.title: 发帖密钥 (posting key)
posting_key.body: 您账户三把私钥中的另一把。发帖密钥用于签署内容 — 聊天消息、反馈、评论。它的信任级别低于活动密钥(它不能转移 BLURT),所以泄露不会那么灾难。Morphit 用它来签署聊天负载和反馈操作;您永远不需要直接接触它。

relay.title: 中继 (relay)
relay.body: Morphit 实例的一部分,处理索引器无法处理的事情 — 接受聊天信封、费用验证、紧急停机执行、反垃圾策略。中继是一个实例的「活动部件」(索引器对区块链只读)。由运营者运行,不是您。

release_op.title: 发布操作 (release op)
release_op.body: 由 @morphit 账户广播的链上操作,发布新版 Morphit 的代码包哈希。前端页面用它来验证自己运行的是未被篡改的代码:每个页面对自己的代码包做哈希,检查该哈希是否已在某个最近的 release_op 中签署。如果哈希不匹配,页面会警告您运营者可能正在提供被篡改的代码。

seed_phrase.title: 助记词
seed_phrase.body: 十二个英文单词,合在一起就是您账户的主备份。从助记词,您的设备可以重新派生出您账户的每一把密钥。如果您的设备坏了并且忘了密码,助记词就是您恢复访问的方式。把它写在纸上。不要截屏。不要邮件发给自己。不要存在与该设备同处的密码管理器里。

sign.title: 签名
sign.body: 用您的某把私钥给一段数据附上一个密码学签名,证明这段数据来自您且未被篡改。当 Morphit 让您「解锁以签名」时,它即将请求区块链接受一个代您发起的动作 — 发布订单、发送消息、支付费用。签名是在您的设备本地进行的;私钥从不离开。

glossary.heading: 术语表
glossary.intro: Morphit 使用的词汇的通俗解释。如果界面里有让您困惑的术语,它应该在这里被定义。如果没有,请提交一个 bug。
glossary.footnote: 这些定义有意保持简短。如需更长或更技术性的解答,请查阅 FAQ。

first_post_starter.heading: 您的第一笔订单?一些更安全的默认设置
first_post_starter.intro: 我们预先填写了一些选项,让您的第一次发布更安全。您可以在下面更改任何选项。
first_post_starter.tip_small_body: 小额首次交易(不到 $50)可以限制如果出现问题时您可能失去的金额。一旦您通过完成的交易建立了信誉,就可以发布更大的订单。
first_post_starter.tip_expiry_body: 我们将到期时间设置为 7 天,而非默认的 90 天。更短的窗口意味着如果您改变主意,过时的报价不会滞留。
first_post_starter.tip_payment_body: 添加您实际接受的付款方式。交易伙伴会选择对他们有用的方式。常见起点:PayPal、Wise、银行转账、当面现金。
first_post_starter.faq_link: 阅读完整的首次交易演练 →

cheat_sheet.heading: Morphit 速查表
cheat_sheet.intro: 一页纸的参考,涵盖奶奶们老是搞混的内容。打印出来,放在键盘旁边。
cheat_sheet.subtitle: 使用 Morphit 时会被问到的所有内容的快速参考。
cheat_sheet.footer: Morphit · morphit.io · 开源 · AGPL-3.0 · 妥善保管此纸。

section_identity.heading: 账户名 vs 助记词 vs 密码
section_identity.account_name_body: 您在 Blurt 链上的公开名字(例如 @alice)。其他人看得到。选择新的是永久的 — 约花费 3 BLURT。
section_identity.seed_phrase_body: 12 个单词。如果您丢失设备,这是回到账户的唯一方法。谁拥有它们,谁就拥有您的账户。写在纸上,妥善保管。
section_identity.password_body: 仅用于此设备,不用于链。在此浏览器中加密您的助记词。如果忘记,输入助记词重新登录。与助记词不同。

section_fees.heading: 挂单费 vs 网络费 vs 交易付款
section_fees.listing_fee_body: Morphit 收取发布订单的费用。很小 — 约 60 BLURT (~$0.12)。首次购买:免费。用 BLURT、BTC 或 XMR 支付。
section_fees.network_fee_body: Bitcoin 或 Monero 网络确认付款收取的费用。给矿工,不给 Morphit。可变 — 在您发送的钱包中查看。
section_fees.trade_payment_body: 您为交易实际发送(或接收)的钱。Morphit 从不持有 — 直接从买家到卖家,平台外进行。

section_assets.heading: 支持的可交易资产
section_assets.btc: Bitcoin。最知名。公开账本 — 任何人都能看到谁付了谁。费用变化很大。
section_assets.xmr: Monero。私密 — 没人能看到谁付了谁。费用通常较低。隐私之选。
section_assets.blurt: Morphit 运行的 Blurt 区块链的代币。用于支付挂单费、发布消息、签署订单。
section_assets.usdt: 泰达稳定币。与美元 1:1 锚定。在四个网络上交易：ERC-20（以太坊）、TRC-20（波场）、SPL（索拉纳）、BEP-20（BNB 智能链）。发送前选择网络 — 跨网络无法恢复。
section_assets.bch: BCH — 比特币现金，透明、去中心化，区块比 BTC 更大
section_assets.ltc: LTC — 莱特币，比特币的快速低费分叉(自 2011 年)。Morphit 上仅供交易。使用莱特币钱包(Electrum-LTC、Litewallet、硬件钱包);接受 L… 旧版、M… 现代 P2SH 和 ltc1… SegWit 地址。
section_assets.dash: DASH — Dash, fast-confirmation Bitcoin-family chain (since 2014). Trade-only on Morphit. Use a Dash wallet (Dash Core, Dash Electrum, hardware wallets); accepts X… P2PKH and 7… P2SH addresses. Optional PrivateSend mixing via masternodes — pre-mix before sharing the address for stronger privacy.
section_assets.usdc: USD Coin stablecoin. Centralized — Circle can freeze any address. Trade-only.
section_assets.dai: DAI — MakerDAO USD-pegged stablecoin. Multi-network (ERC-20/Polygon/Base/Arbitrum, all EVM). Trade-only. Partly USDC-backed.
section_assets.doge: DOGE — Dogecoin, transparent proof-of-work chain (since 2013), merge-mined with Litecoin. Trade-only on Morphit. Use a Dogecoin wallet (Dogecoin Core, MyDoge, hardware wallets); accepts D… P2PKH and 9…/A… P2SH addresses. No native privacy upgrade —
section_assets.zec: ZEC — Zcash, proof-of-work chain with optional zero-knowledge shielded transactions (Sapling + Orchard pools). Supports both transparent (t1/t3, base58, similar to Bitcoin's legacy addresses) and shielded (zs1/u1, bech32, hides sender/recipient/amount) addresses. Trade-only — cannot pay listing fees.
section_assets.arrr: ARRR — Pirate Chain.  Proof-of-work cryptocurrency with chain-level shielded transactions via the Sapling zk-SNARK pool (every transaction is private by construction).  Trade-only on Morphit.  Use a Pirate Chain wallet (Treasure Chest, Pirate.Black, Verus); only one address format exists (zs1 Sapling shielded, 78 chars — visually identical to Zcash Sapling).
section_assets.dcr: DCR — Decred.  Hybrid Proof-of-Work + Proof-of-Stake cryptocurrency with on-chain governance (Politeia).  Trade-only on Morphit.  Use a Decred wallet (dcrwallet, Decrediton, Cake Wallet); two address formats (Ds P2PKH and Dc P2SH, 35 chars each).  Opt-in CoinShuffle++ mixing available wallet-side for users who want transaction-level privacy.

section_recovery.heading: 如果出了问题
section_recovery.lost_seed_body: 没有恢复途径。Morphit 没有副本。如果您仍能访问设备,立即转出资金,重新创建账户。
section_recovery.lost_password_body: 点击「登录」,选择「导入助记词」。输入您的 12 个单词。设置新密码。
section_recovery.lost_device_body: 在新设备上,前往 morphit.io,点击「登录」,选择「导入助记词」,输入您的 12 个单词。设置新密码。
section_recovery.suspect_compromise_label: 怀疑有人拿到了您的助记词?
section_recovery.suspect_compromise_body: 立即将资金转移到新账户。任何拥有助记词的人都有完全控制权。区块链上没有「冻结」按钮。

privacy_warnings.usdt_centralized: 交易 USDT 前需要知道的两件事：Tether 公司发行和管理 USDT，并具有冻结地址的技术能力（且曾使用过）。交易在每个支持的网络（以太坊、波场、索拉纳、BNB 智能链）上都是公开可见的 — 这是那些链的特性。选择适合你交易的资产。
privacy_warnings.usdc_centralized: Two things to know about USDC before trading: Circle issues and administers USDC and has the technical ability to freeze addresses (and has used it). Transactions are publicly visible on each supported network (Ethereum, Solana, Base, Polygon) — a property of those chains. Pick the asset that fits your trade.
privacy_warnings.dai_partly_centralized: Three things to know about DAI before trading: (1) Unlike USDT and USDC, DAI's token contract has no admin-controlled freeze function — MakerDAO can't blacklist your address. This is a real decentralization advantage. (2) DAI is partly backed by USDC via the Peg Stability Module, so Circle's freeze power over USDC indirectly affects DAI redemption when the PSM holds USDC. (3) Like all stablecoins, DAI transactions are publicly visible on each supported network (Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum) — a property of those chains, no on-chain privacy. Pick the asset that fits your trade.

picker.requiredHint: 必填 — 没有默认网络。每次 USDT 交易都必须选择一个。
picker.crossNetworkWarning: 跨网络发送将永久损失你的资金。将 Ethereum 上的 USDT 发送到 Tron 地址（或反之）是不可恢复的。

address_share.warning: 仅在 {network} 上发送 USDT。在任何其他网络上向此地址发送 USDT 将永久损失你的资金。

picker.requiredHint: Required — there is no default network. You must pick one for every USDC trade.
picker.crossNetworkWarning: Cross-network sends lose your funds permanently. Sending USDC on Ethereum to a Solana address (or vice versa) is unrecoverable. Note that Ethereum, Base, and Polygon addresses look identical (all start with 0x) — the network choice is what tells your wallet which chain to broadcast on.

picker.label: DAI network
picker.requiredHint: Required. Pick the same network your counterparty uses.
picker.crossNetworkWarning: All four DAI networks use the same address format. An address that's valid on Polygon is also valid-format on Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum — but each chain holds a separate balance. DAI sent on the wrong chain is unrecoverable. Both parties must agree on the network before sending.

address_share.warning: Stablecoin trade — DAI is more decentralized than USDT/USDC at the contract level (no admin freeze) but partly backed by USDC via the PSM. Pick a network with both counterparties.

privacy.index_meta_description: How to make your trades more private on transparent and private chains. Per-asset guidance covering fresh addresses, opt-in privacy tech, and common pitfalls.
privacy.index_intro: Most assets traded on Morphit (BTC, BCH, LTC, DASH, DOGE, ZEC, ARRR, DCR, BLURT, USDT, USDC, DAI) live on transparent chains — any observer can read the chain history. There are concrete steps you can take to make YOUR trades much harder to link, profile, or surveil. This is registry-driven: the next asset Morphit adds will get a guide automatically.
privacy.section_fresh_addresses: Use a fresh address every trade
privacy.section_opt_in_tech_intro: Standards that wallets in this ecosystem may implement. Morphit does NOT recommend specific wallet software — even reputable wallets have been compromised. Search for a wallet that supports these standards and review its trust posture yourself.
privacy.no_wallet_recommendation: Morphit does NOT recommend specific wallet software. Even reputable wallets have been compromised or have had hidden flaws. The privacy techniques here are protocol standards, not endorsements — your wallet, your responsibility.

fresh_address_advice.subaddress: This chain supports stealth/subaddress technology natively. Your wallet derives a fresh receive address (subaddress) per trade from your view key. The recipient sees a unique address every time; chain observers cannot link multiple trades to the same wallet.
fresh_address_advice.hd-derived: This chain uses transparent addresses with no native stealth. The standard practice: use a Hierarchical Deterministic (BIP-32) wallet that derives a new receive address per request. Most modern wallets do this automatically. The cost of address reuse is severe — every trade you accept at the same address builds a public record of your activity.
fresh_address_advice.account-reuse: This chain is account-based — your account name is your address. Fresh-account-per-trade is not practical (each new account costs chain resources). Accept that this asset has the highest amount-correlation risk on Morphit. For high-value trades, consider using an alt-account dedicated to that trade.

mweb.name: MWEB (MimbleWimble Extension Blocks)
mweb.explain: A native Litecoin protocol-level privacy feature. MWEB hides transaction amounts and breaks the address-to-amount link for transfers that opt in. Per-transaction; not chain-wide. Look for wallets that surface "MWEB" or "Extension Blocks" as an option when sending.

cashfusion.name: CashFusion
cashfusion.explain: A Bitcoin Cash CoinJoin variant designed by the BCH community. Mixes inputs and outputs of varying amounts to defeat both common-input-ownership and amount-correlation heuristics. Run from a wallet that supports CashFusion before or after a trade to launder the on-chain history.

coinjoin.name: CoinJoin
coinjoin.explain: A family of protocols where multiple participants pool inputs and outputs into a single transaction, breaking the common-input-ownership heuristic that links coins to one owner. Multiple implementations exist with different trust models — choose carefully and read the implementation's threat model.

payjoin.name: PayJoin (BIP-78)
payjoin.explain: A two-party cooperative transaction protocol. Sender and receiver both contribute inputs, so chain observers cannot apply the standard "all inputs come from the same wallet" heuristic. Morphit's address-share modal includes an optional PayJoin endpoint field — if both wallets support BIP-78, the trade automatically uses PayJoin.

privatesend.name: PrivateSend
privatesend.explain: Dash's native CoinJoin variant. Uses denominated input/output amounts and masternode coordination to mix coins among multiple participants, breaking the link between sender and receiver on-chain. Run multiple mixing rounds (more rounds = larger anonymity set = higher fee). Pre-mix in your Dash wallet BEFORE sharing the address — by the time the funds reach Morphit they're already mixed.

shielded-pools.name: Shielded pools (Sapling + Orchard)
shielded-pools.explain: Zcash's protocol-level privacy. Shielded transactions (zs1 Sapling, u1 Unified Address) use zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) to hide sender, recipient, and amount on chain. Sapling is the established shielded pool (since 2018); Orchard is the newer pool (Network Upgrade 5, 2022) accessed through Unified Addresses. Per-address — recipients pick z/u-addr for shielded transactions or t-addr for transparent. Both transparent and shielded are first-class on the protocol. Wallets that fully support shielded sends: Zashi (mobile, official from Electric Coin Co, Sapling + Orchard), Zecwallet (desktop, Sapling), Nighthawk Wallet (mobile, Sapling). Older wallets may only support transparent (t-addr) sends, so confirm your counterparty's wallet supports the address type you intend to use.

csppmix.name: CoinShuffle++ (CSPP) mixing
csppmix.explain: A wallet-side mixing protocol that bundles your transaction inputs with other participants in a single multi-party round.  After mixing, your outputs are no longer linkable to your original inputs on chain.  Integrated into dcrwallet for Decred — enable the "Mix Account" option.  Opt-in (you choose when to mix); off-protocol (mixing rounds aren't enforced by consensus).

common_practices.fresh_per_trade: **Use a fresh receive address for every trade.** Your wallet should support this; if it doesn't, look for one that does. Address reuse is the single biggest leak.
common_practices.coin_control: **Practice coin control when spending.** When sending coins later, avoid combining the trade output with coins from another source — that combines their address histories permanently.
common_practices.network_layer: **Broadcast through Tor or your wallet's privacy mode.** Your home IP address sees the transaction first; nodes near your IP can correlate it to you. A Tor-aware wallet broadcasts through Tor by default.
common_practices.kyc_touchpoints: **Avoid sending trade coins to or from KYC exchanges.** Once trade coins touch a KYC exchange, the trade becomes legally identifiable by combining exchange records with chain data. If you need to bridge to fiat, route through a self-custodied intermediate step.

what_not_to_do.reuse_address: Do not paste your same receive address into multiple trades.
what_not_to_do.exact_amount: Do not send the exact amount listed on the order — Morphit's amount-randomizer toggle (the "🔐 Randomize amount" checkbox in the address-share modal) breaks this; leave it ON.
what_not_to_do.combine_utxos: Do not combine the trade output with coins from a different source when you later spend it.
what_not_to_do.clearnet_broadcast: Do not broadcast from your home IP via a non-private wallet — use Tor.

btc.one_line: Transparent chain, fully decentralized — opt-in mixing protocols available.
btc.intro: Bitcoin is the most-analyzed chain in the world. Every transaction is public; every address can be tracked over time. The privacy practices below dramatically reduce how easily a third party can profile your trades — without requiring you to leave BTC.
btc.meta_description: Privacy practices for Bitcoin trades on Morphit: fresh addresses, PayJoin, CoinJoin, and what to avoid.

xmr.one_line: Privacy by default — stealth addresses, hidden amounts, ring signatures.
xmr.intro: Monero's chain-level privacy hides sender, recipient, and amount by default. By default, your address, amount, and counterparty are hidden from third parties. The practices below are minor tightenings; the chain itself does the heavy lifting.
xmr.meta_description: Privacy practices for Monero trades on Morphit: subaddresses and amount handling.

blurt.one_line: Coordination chain — transparent and account-based. Lowest privacy on Morphit.
blurt.intro: BLURT is Morphit's coordination chain — orders, chat ciphertexts, fees, and reputation all live here. The chain is fully public and account-based, meaning every BLURT transfer involving your account is permanently visible to anyone. There is no opt-in privacy technology for BLURT.
blurt.caveats: BLURT is structurally the least private asset on Morphit. Your account name is your address; you cannot rotate it. For trades where on-chain privacy matters more than speed and cost, prefer XMR, BTC (with PayJoin), BCH (with CashFusion), LTC (with MWEB), or DASH (with PrivateSend).
blurt.meta_description: Privacy considerations for BLURT trades on Morphit: account-based chain, transparent by design.

usdt.one_line: Centralized — Tether can freeze any address. Transparent on every chain.
usdt.intro: USDT's privacy issue is structurally different from the other transparent assets: it's centralized. Tether Inc. can freeze any USDT address on any host chain, and they have used this ability in the past. No amount of address rotation or transaction obfuscation changes Tether's freeze capability.
usdt.caveats: Even with perfect on-chain privacy practices, USDT remains centrally freezable. Practical on-chain privacy on USDT host chains (Ethereum, Tron, Solana, BSC) is the same as on any transparent EVM/UTXO/account chain — your privacy depends on the host chain's opt-in privacy ecosystem (Tornado Cash on ETH, etc.), which we do not endorse or describe further here.
usdt.meta_description: Privacy considerations for USDT trades on Morphit: centralization risk and host-chain transparency.

bch.one_line: Transparent, decentralized — CashFusion provides opt-in mixing.
bch.intro: Bitcoin Cash shares Bitcoin's transparency model: every transaction visible on chain, every address linkable. CashFusion (a BCH-community CoinJoin variant with amount-randomization) is the main opt-in privacy technology and is well-integrated into several BCH wallets.
bch.meta_description: Privacy practices for Bitcoin Cash trades on Morphit: fresh addresses, CashFusion, and what to avoid.

ltc.one_line: Transparent, decentralized — MWEB provides opt-in chain-level privacy.
ltc.intro: Litecoin shares Bitcoin's transparency at the base layer, but adds MWEB (MimbleWimble Extension Blocks) — a chain-level opt-in privacy feature that hides amounts and breaks address linkability for transfers that opt in. This is the closest a Bitcoin-family chain comes to native privacy.
ltc.meta_description: Privacy practices for Litecoin trades on Morphit: fresh addresses, MWEB, and what to avoid.

dash.one_line: Transparent base layer, decentralized — PrivateSend provides masternode-coordinated opt-in mixing.
dash.intro: Dash forked from Litecoin in 2014 and shares the same transparent base layer — every address balance and transaction is publicly visible. The chain is fully decentralized; no issuer can freeze addresses. Dash adds PrivateSend, a CoinJoin variant coordinated by the masternode network, providing opt-in mixing at the wallet level. Pre-mixing several rounds before sharing your receiving address is the strongest privacy practice on Dash.
dash.meta_description: Privacy practices for Dash trades on Morphit: fresh addresses, PrivateSend pre-mixing, and what to avoid.
dash.caveats: PrivateSend's anonymity set depends on simultaneous mixing participants. Off-peak hours = smaller set = weaker unlinkability. Masternode coordination is a trust trade-off: the protocol is non-custodial (masternodes never hold your coins) but the coordinator sees the mixing pattern.

usdc.one_line: Centralized — Circle can freeze any address. Transparent on every chain.
usdc.intro: USDC's privacy posture mirrors USDT's: it's centralized. Circle (USDC's issuer) can freeze any USDC address on any host chain, and has done so on regulatory request. No amount of address rotation or transaction obfuscation changes Circle's freeze capability. The amount-correlation defense (jitter) IS active for USDC trades — see /{lang}/faq#monero_amount_jitter — but jitter addresses a different threat than centralization.
usdc.caveats: Even with perfect on-chain privacy practices, USDC remains centrally freezable. Practical on-chain privacy on USDC host chains (Ethereum, Solana, Base, Polygon) is the same as on any transparent EVM/account chain — your privacy depends on the host chain's opt-in privacy ecosystem, which we do not endorse or describe further here. BEP-20 USDC on BNB Chain is intentionally NOT supported: that variant is Binance-Peg (Binance-custodied wrapper of Circle-issued USDC), adding a second custodian to the existing one.
usdc.meta_description: Privacy considerations for USDC trades on Morphit: centralization risk, host-chain transparency, and the amount-jitter defense.

dai.one_line: DAI — USD-pegged stablecoin governed by MakerDAO. No admin freeze on the token, but partly backed by USDC.
dai.meta_description: Honest privacy notes for trading DAI on Morphit: more decentralized than USDT/USDC at the contract level, partly backed by USDC via the Peg Stability Module.
dai.intro: DAI is MakerDAO's USD-pegged stablecoin, deployed on Ethereum and several other EVM chains. It's the most-decentralized US-dollar-pegged asset Morphit supports — but "decentralized" doesn't mean "freeze-immune" or "fully crypto-backed" anymore. This page is the honest picture so you can choose with eyes open.

doge.one_line: Transparent base layer, decentralized via PoW, no native privacy upgrade.
doge.intro: Dogecoin launched in 2013 as a fair-launched fork of an earlier Litecoin variant. Like Bitcoin, every address balance and transaction is publicly visible on the chain. The chain is fully decentralized; no issuer or foundation can freeze addresses. Since 2014 it has been merge-mined with Litecoin (auxiliary proof-of-work), inheriting Litecoin's hashrate security without competing for it.
doge.meta_description: Privacy practices for Dogecoin trades on Morphit: fresh addresses, avoiding chain heuristics, and what tradeoffs to expect.
doge.caveats: Dogecoin has no native privacy upgrade — no PrivateSend equivalent, no confidential transactions, no segwit-enabled mixing. Every receive address you publish on Morphit can be linked to its on-chain history forever. Use a fresh HD-derived address for every trade (your wallet usually does this automatically).

zec.one_line: Transparent and shielded address types coexist; recipients pick per address.
zec.intro: Zcash launched in 2016 as the first deployment of zk-SNARK-based shielded transactions in a cryptocurrency. The chain supports two address families: transparent (t1/t3) which behave like Bitcoin's legacy addresses with publicly visible amounts, and shielded (zs1 Sapling, u1 Unified Address bundling Orchard receivers) which use zero-knowledge proofs to hide sender, recipient, and amount on chain. Per-trade, the recipient picks the address type that matches their preferred posture. Both are first-class on the protocol.
zec.meta_description: Privacy practices for Zcash trades on Morphit: choosing between transparent and shielded addresses (t-addr, z-addr, u-addr), wallet recommendations, and what each privacy pool does.
zec.caveats: Shielded-to-shielded transactions hide sender, recipient, and amount on chain. Mixed transactions (shielded-to-transparent or transparent-to-shielded) reveal one side. Transparent-to-transparent reveals both. If your goal is to minimize linkability, use a shielded address (zs1 or u1) and ask the counterparty to send from a shielded address. Wallet support varies: Zashi (mobile, official from Electric Coin Co, Sapling + Orchard), Zecwallet (desktop, Sapling), Nighthawk (mobile, Sapling) — not every wallet supports every address type, so verify your counterparty's wallet handles the address type you publish before sharing it.

arrr.one_line: Chain-level shielded transactions via the Sapling zk-SNARK pool; every transfer hides sender, recipient, and amount by construction.
arrr.intro:
Pirate Chain (ARRR) launched in 2018 as a fork of the Zcash codebase, configured so that the Sapling shielded pool is the only available transaction type.  Every transfer goes through zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) that hide sender, recipient, and amount on chain.  Pirate Chain sunsetted the transparent pool early in the chain's life and forcibly migrated all transparent balances to shielded — there is no transparent address option.  Addresses use the `zs1` Sapling format (bech32, 78 chars total), visually identical to Zcash Sapling addresses.

The practices below cover wallet-side hygiene that survives even chain-level shielding — the on-chain payload is private, but what you share off-chain (which addresses you publish, which counterparties you transact with) is what links your Morphit trades together over time.
arrr.meta_description: Privacy practices for Pirate Chain trades on Morphit: chain-level shielded transactions, fresh-address hygiene, and wallet compatibility.
arrr.caveats:
Pirate Chain's chain-level shielding hides sender, recipient, and amount on chain — but it does not erase off-chain linkability.

- **Share fresh addresses per trade.**  Using the same `zs1` address across multiple Morphit listings lets observers correlate your orders even though the chain itself reveals nothing.  Generate a fresh receive address per trade (Pirate Chain wallets derive these from your HD seed).
- **Wallet compatibility.**  Not every wallet supports Pirate Chain (the major options are Treasure Chest, Pirate.Black, and Verus-integrated Pirate).  Confirm your counterparty has a compatible wallet before agreeing to a price.
- **Network-layer privacy still matters.**  Broadcasting through Tor or your wallet's privacy mode keeps your home IP off the chain's view of you.
- **Visual collision with Zcash Sapling addresses.**  Pirate Chain `zs1` addresses look exactly like Zcash `zs1` addresses.  Morphit's per-asset tab and placeholder disambiguate, but if you copy an address from a different context, confirm it belongs to the chain you intend to send on.

dcr.one_line: Hybrid PoW/PoS cryptocurrency with on-chain governance (Politeia) and opt-in CoinShuffle++ (CSPP) wallet-side mixing.
dcr.intro:
Decred (DCR) launched in 2016 as a hybrid Proof-of-Work + Proof-of-Stake cryptocurrency with on-chain governance.  Every block is mined by PoW miners AND voted on by 5 PoS ticket-holders chosen pseudo-randomly from the staking pool — neither group can change the protocol rules unilaterally.  On-chain governance via Politeia lets stakeholders propose, debate, and ratify protocol changes; treasury funds (10% of block reward) flow through community vote.

The chain is transparent at the base layer — sender, recipient, and amount are visible on chain like Bitcoin.  Decred ships an opt-in CoinShuffle++ (CSPP) mixing protocol integrated into dcrwallet: users can enable mixing in their wallet to break the on-chain transaction graph between deposit and withdrawal, similar in posture to Bitcoin coinjoin or Dash PrivateSend.

The practices below cover wallet-side hygiene to make the most of Decred's privacy features.
dcr.meta_description: Privacy practices for Decred trades on Morphit: hybrid PoW/PoS chain, on-chain governance, opt-in CoinShuffle++ wallet mixing, and fresh-address hygiene.
dcr.caveats:
Decred is transparent at the base layer; mixing is opt-in and wallet-side.

- **Share fresh addresses per trade.**  Using the same `Ds` or `Dc` address across multiple Morphit listings lets observers correlate your orders on a fully transparent chain.  Generate a fresh receive address per trade (Decred wallets derive these from your HD seed).
- **Use CSPP mixing if you want transaction-level privacy.**  In dcrwallet enable the "Mix Account" option; deposits flow through CoinShuffle++ rounds with other participants before becoming spendable from your mixed account.  Mixing rounds happen approximately every 20 minutes on mainnet.
- **Wallet compatibility.**  The official wallets are dcrwallet (CLI/headless), Decrediton (GUI), and Cake Wallet (mobile, DCR mode).  Some other wallets support DCR send/receive but not CSPP mixing.
- **Network-layer privacy still matters.**  Broadcasting through Tor or your wallet's privacy mode keeps your home IP off the chain's view of you.
- **Politeia treasury proposals are public.**  Decred's on-chain governance system shows every proposal, vote, and discussion publicly.  This isn't a Morphit-trading concern, but worth knowing if you participate in DCR governance.
